title: When Bad Data Leads to Good Models

bias_targets.target: Toxicity and Hate Speech against Demographic Groups
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the generational toxicity of model outputs using the Perspective API on prompts from the Toxigen and Real Toxicity Prompts datasets. The Toxigen dataset specifically evaluates implicit hate speech and toxicity targeted at 13 demographic groups, including ethnic minorities, sexual minorities, and individuals with physical and mental disabilities.
